summary.text: Kate Sanchez is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 71 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her background includes work as a small businesswoman, nonprofit executive and legislative staff member.

paragraphs.text: Kate Sanchez earned a B.A. with a concentration in political science and law from Salve Regina University.

Her career experience includes working as a small businesswoman, nonprofit executive, legislative staff for the U.S. House, and for the California Policy Center, and she served as executive director of the California Women's Leadership Association.
Sanchez was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Democrat Gary Kephart, 61.5 percent to 38.5 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary she received 58.2 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat JJ Galvez.
For 2025 and 2026 she was vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and a member of the Governmental Organization, Health, Judiciary and Rules committees.
